Definition: to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net
BiblicalUsage: Charak is catching game in a net and roasting it, and it appears once: the slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting, but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the proverb is a small economics lesson: the lazy man cannot even finish what he started.
